title: Report to Lanka
disclaimer: New location Lanka court. Ravana one lockable face. Wound still present.
story_goal: Surpanakha before Ravana; she describes Sita; his pride turns to wanting her.
framework_goal: New location (Lanka court) + new lead (Ravana) + wounded-Surpanakha continuity.
gate: Ravana bible + Lanka lock signed; her wound still present.
narrative_summary: Night court. She shows the wound and names Sita. Ravana's hunger finds a shape.

fact_checks.claim: Surpanakha's report moves Ravana to desire Sita.

panels.scene_description: Lanka court lock: stone, lamps, one primary Ravana face. Pride in the shoulders.
panels.caption: Lanka does not ask permission of the forest.

shot_card.blocking: king on the seat, small attendants as texture
shot_card.dramatic_purpose: Lock Lanka and Ravana king form.

panels.scene_description: She enters wounded. Midface must match ep02. Court does not look away.

shot_card.camera: her approach up the floor, him waiting
shot_card.lighting: her wound in lamp light — not pretty

panels.scene_description: She tells of two men and a woman. Desire and humiliation in the same mouth.
panels.dialogue: SURPANAKHA: They live like saints. They cut like butchers. The woman is the reason you should care.

panels.scene_description: Ravana listening. Appetite, not cartoon lust-face.

shot_card.lighting: gold on jewelry, eyes in shadow

panels.scene_description: She describes Sita without stripping her for the court.
panels.dialogue: SURPANAKHA: Earth-colored. Unafraid. She looked at me as if I were a weather.

shot_card.blocking: hands describing size of a person, not a body catalogue
shot_card.continuity_from: sita bible — we do not redraw Sita here; words only

panels.scene_description: He stands. The court feels the decision before the sentence.
panels.dialogue: RAVANA: Then the forest has kept what it cannot keep.

shot_card.camera: two-shot, him rising, her looking up
shot_card.lighting: lamps throw his shadow on her

panels.scene_description: Window or map north. Sea air. He is already gone from the room.
panels.caption: A king does not steal. He collects.

shot_card.camera: him at the opening, back three-quarter, one face still readable in reflection or profile
shot_card.lighting: cooler sea night vs lamp gold

panels.scene_description: She remains. Wound. Empty court. Not healed.
panels.caption: She got what she came for. It will not put her face back.
